moments.title: Macy Gray turns 59
moments.blurb: The distinctive-voiced soul singer, known for her hit 'I Try', Macy Gray, celebrates her 59th birthday today.

angles.name: Macy's distinctive voice
angles.copy: Happy 59th birthday to the one and only Macy Gray! That voice is still instantly recognisable. What's your favourite Macy Gray track?

angles.name: I Try nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember 'I Try'? Today, Macy Gray turns 59! Still sounds as good as ever. Let us know if you're listening to her today.

moments.title: Roger Waters is 83
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and songwriter Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Pink Floyd legend
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Pink Floyd legend Roger Waters, who turns 83 today! What's your go-to Pink Floyd album?

angles.name: The Wall
angles.copy: From 'The Wall' to 'Dark Side of the Moon', Roger Waters' influence is undeniable. He's 83 today!

moments.title: CeCe Peniston turns 57
moments.blurb: American dance music star CeCe Peniston, famous for 'Finally', celebrates her 57th birthday.

angles.name: Finally hit
angles.copy: It's CeCe Peniston's 57th birthday! Time to crank up 'Finally' and get those weekend vibes going.

angles.name: Dance anthem
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the voice behind one of the biggest dance anthems of all time! CeCe Peniston is 57 today.

moments.title: Gloria Gaynor turns 83

angles.name: I Will Survive power
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the incredible Gloria Gaynor turns 83! Her music still gives us all the strength. What's your favourite lyric from 'I Will Survive'?

angles.name: Disco queen
angles.copy: The original disco queen, Gloria Gaynor, celebrates her 83rd birthday tomorrow. Get ready to dance!

angles.name: Pretenders icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders, celebrating tomorrow! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

angles.name: Brass In Pocket
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Chrissie Hynde turns 75 tomorrow. 'Brass In Pocket' anyone?

moments.title: Pink turns 47

angles.name: Pop-punk energy

angles.name: Iconic anthems
angles.copy: From 'Get the Party Started' to 'Cover Me In Sunshine', Pink's anthems are legendary. She celebrates her 47th birthday on Tuesday!

moments.title: Wiz Khalifa is 39

angles.name: Rap superstar
angles.copy: Happy 39th birthday to Wiz Khalifa on Tuesday! What's the track that introduced you to his music?

angles.name: See You Again
angles.copy: Turning 39 on Tuesday, Wiz Khalifa has given us some massive tracks. 'See You Again' is still a huge one!

moments.title: Otis Redding Way dedication
moments.blurb: Macon-Bibb County will dedicate portions of Cotton Avenue and Mulberry Street Lane as 'Otis Redding Way' on Wednesday, celebrating what would have been the soul legend's 85th birthday.

angles.name: Enduring legacy
angles.copy: A fantastic tribute! On what would have been his 85th birthday this Wednesday, a street will be dedicated to the legendary Otis Redding. What an enduring legacy!

angles.name: Sitting on the Dock
angles.copy: They're dedicating 'Otis Redding Way' on Wednesday! His music still moves us decades later. 'Sitting On The Dock Of The Bay' is a timeless classic.

angles.name: Smooth vocals
angles.copy: Happy 51st birthday to the king of smooth, Michael Bublé, on Wednesday! What's your favourite song to get lost in his voice?

angles.name: Christmas album anticipation
angles.copy: It's Michael Bublé's 51st birthday this Wednesday! Does this mean we can start thinking about THAT Christmas album yet? Asking for a friend...

angles.name: Rom-com king

angles.name: Notting Hill forever
